title: Figure 9. A DNA nanomachine driven by sequential addition of DNA control strands
description: Cyclic schematic of colored DNA strands switching a nanomachine between "Open" and "Closed" states, with arrows showing addition of a "Set strand," an "Unset strand," and release of "Waste" duplex. Captioned "Figure 9. A DNA nanomachine driven by repeated sequential addition of DNA control strands (82)." Appears under the heading "DNA-Based Designs for Molecular Computers."
